name: Majima Akinori
source: A lonewolf who needs no assistance. He prides in his fist and is aiming to become a world champion in boxing. Even during the game he uses nothing other than his fists against weaponry.
translation: A lonewolf who needs no assistance. He prides in his fist and is aiming to become a world champion in boxing. Even during the game he uses nothing other than his fists against weaponry.
